Wonderful French styled bistro and pastry restaurant in HCMC.
May 2025 • Solo
This place is a lovely breath of fresh air for Western or European travelers. The service I received in this popular restaurant was very friendly. I was looking for good breakfast place and L’usine was the answer. Ordered the “big breakfast” and Vietnamese coffee. Both were excellent and have to warn you the “big breakfast” is really big. They also specialize in pastries, but if you order later in the day then many of their pastry favorites are sold out. Definitely would recommend Cafe L’usine.

Great taste of western lunch options
Aug 2023 • Family
After thee weeks Vietnam and Cambodia we were looking for a lunch location with Western food options. We had the clubsandwiches, muesli bowls and egg plant sandwich. All food was fresh and tasteful. The juices were also good (but they are almost everywhere good in Vietnam and Cambodia with all the fresh fruit available!). This place can be found at the top floor of the Saigon shopping centre. Great place for having lunch.
